about: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo, daily, grid cell centred 37.75 N 128.75 E (about 25 km across; contains both Daegwallyeong and Gangneung). January and February, 1980-2010. Snowfall in cm, precipitation in mm, temperature in C, humidity in %, wind direction in degrees (from), speed in km/h. Licence CC BY 4.0. Reanalysed, not observed.
